title: Relative Clauses and Complex Sentences
description: Lær å bruke relativsetninger og leddsetninger for å skrive mer avanserte og informasjonsrike setninger på engelsk.
competenceGoals: bruke sentrale mønstre for setningsbygning, verbtider og tekstbinding i kommunikasjon

content.content:
## Relativsetninger -- bygg komplekse setninger

For å skrive godt engelsk i 9. klasse trenger du mer enn korte, enkle setninger. Du trenger å kunne bygge **komplekse setninger** (*complex sentences*) som inneholder mer informasjon.

En **relativsetning** (*relative clause*) er en leddsetning som gir ekstra informasjon om et substantiv. Den starter med et **relativpronomen** (*relative pronoun*):

- **who** -- om personer
- **which** -- om ting og dyr
- **that** -- om personer og ting (mer uformelt)
- **whose** -- eierskap
- **where** -- om steder
- **when** -- om tid

content.title: Defining vs. Non-defining Relative Clauses
content.content:
**Defining relative clause** (bestemmende relativsetning):
- Gir nødvendig informasjon -- uten den vet vi ikke hvem/hva vi snakker om
- INGEN komma
- Kan bruke "that"
- "The student **who won the prize** is from my class."
- "The book **that I read last week** was amazing."

**Non-defining relative clause** (ikke-bestemmende relativsetning):
- Gir ekstra informasjon som ikke er nødvendig for å forstå setningen
- MED komma
- Kan IKKE bruke "that"
- "My sister, **who lives in London**, is a doctor."
- "The Eiffel Tower, **which was built in 1889**, is in Paris."

**Test:** Fjern relativsetningen. Gir setningen fortsatt mening?
- JA → non-defining (med komma)
- NEI → defining (uten komma)

content.title: Eksempel: Defining vs. non-defining
content.problem:
Hva er forskjellen mellom disse to setningene?

1. "My brother who lives in Bergen is a teacher."
2. "My brother, who lives in Bergen, is a teacher."
content.solution:
**Setning 1 (defining -- uten komma):**
- Impliserer at du har flere brødre
- Relativsetningen spesifiserer *hvilken* bror: den som bor i Bergen
- Uten relativsetningen vet vi ikke hvem vi snakker om

**Setning 2 (non-defining -- med komma):**
- Du har bare én bror
- "who lives in Bergen" er tilleggsinformasjon
- Uten relativsetningen gir setningen fortsatt mening: "My brother is a teacher."

**Konklusjon:** Kommaene gjør en faktisk forskjell for betydningen!

exercise.task: Fyll inn med riktig relativpronomen: who, which, that, whose, where eller when.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: The woman _____ lives next door is a doctor.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: The film _____ we watched was really boring.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: This is the park _____ we used to play as children.

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: The boy _____ father is a pilot wants to be an astronaut.

subTasks.label: e
subTasks.task: Summer is the season _____ most Norwegians go on holiday.

exercise.solution: a) who, b) that/which, c) where, d) whose, e) when. Husk: who = person, which/that = ting, where = sted, whose = eierskap, when = tid.

exercise.task: Sett sammen to setninger til én ved hjelp av en relativsetning.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: "J.K. Rowling is a famous author. She wrote Harry Potter."
subTasks.solution: J.K. Rowling, who wrote Harry Potter, is a famous author. (Non-defining -- vi vet hvem Rowling er)

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: "I met a girl. Her mother works at our school."
subTasks.solution: I met a girl whose mother works at our school. (Defining -- 'whose' viser eierskap)

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: "That is the restaurant. We had dinner there last Friday."
subTasks.solution: That is the restaurant where we had dinner last Friday. (Defining -- spesifiserer hvilken restaurant)

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: "The phone is expensive. I want to buy it."
subTasks.solution: The phone that/which I want to buy is expensive. (Defining -- spesifiserer hvilken telefon)

hints: Se om relativsetningen er nødvendig (defining) eller tilleggsinformasjon (non-defining)
exercise.solution: Relativsetninger gjør det mulig å kombinere informasjon i én setning i stedet for to korte.

content.content:
## Andre typer leddsetninger for komplekse setninger

I tillegg til relativsetninger finnes andre typer leddsetninger som gjør skrivingen din mer avansert:

**Tidssetninger (time clauses):**
- "**When** I arrived, the party had already started."
- "**Before** you leave, please close the window."
- "**After** she graduated, she moved to Oslo."
- "**While** I was studying, my phone rang."

**Årsakssetninger (reason clauses):**
- "She stayed home **because** she was ill."
- "**Since** you asked, I'll tell you the truth."
- "**As** it was raining, we took the bus."

**Formålssetninger (purpose clauses):**
- "I studied hard **so that** I could pass the exam."
- "She whispered **in order not to** wake the baby."

**Innrømmelsessetninger (concession clauses):**
- "**Although** it was cold, we went swimming."
- "**Even though** she was tired, she kept working."
- "**Despite** the rain, we had a great time."

exercise.task: Forbind setningene med konjunksjonen i parentes.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: She was tired. She continued working. (although)
subTasks.solution: Although she was tired, she continued working.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: I will call you. I arrive at the airport. (when)
subTasks.solution: I will call you when I arrive at the airport. (Merk: present simple i when-setningen, ikke will)

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: He missed the bus. He woke up late. (because)
subTasks.solution: He missed the bus because he woke up late.

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: She studied hard. She wanted to get good grades. (so that)
subTasks.solution: She studied hard so that she could get good grades.

hints: Husk: Etter 'when', 'before', 'after' i fremtid bruker vi present simple, IKKE will
Legg komma etter leddsetningen når den kommer først
exercise.solution: a) Although she was tired, she continued working. b) I will call you when I arrive. c) He missed the bus because he woke up late. d) She studied hard so that she could get good grades.

exercise.task: Skriveoppgave: Forbedre en tekst med relativsetninger og leddsetninger.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task:
Her er en tekst med bare korte, enkle setninger. Skriv den om slik at den inneholder minst 3 relativsetninger og 2 andre leddsetninger:

"I have a friend. She is from England. She moved to Norway last year. She likes skiing. She had never tried it before. She learned quickly. She practices every weekend. She wants to compete next winter."
subTasks.solution: Eksempel: 'I have a friend who is from England. She moved to Norway last year, where she discovered skiing. Although she had never tried it before, she learned quickly because she is very sporty. She practices every weekend so that she can compete next winter, which is her big dream.'

hints: Bruk who, which, where for relativsetninger
Bruk although, because, when, so that for andre leddsetninger
exercise.solution: Å kombinere korte setninger til lengre, mer komplekse setninger gjør teksten din mer moden og lettlest.

content.content:
## Oppsummering

**Relativpronomen:**
- who (person), which (ting), that (begge), whose (eierskap), where (sted), when (tid)

**Defining vs. non-defining:**
- Defining: nødvendig info, ingen komma: "The girl who called is my friend."
- Non-defining: tilleggsinfo, med komma: "Maria, who called earlier, is my friend."

**Andre leddsetninger:**
- Tid: when, before, after, while
- Årsak: because, since, as
- Formål: so that, in order to
- Innrømmelse: although, even though, despite

**Tips for bedre skriving:**
- Varier setningslengden: noen korte, noen lange
- Bruk leddsetninger for å vise sammenhenger (årsak, tid, kontrast)
- Unngå å skrive bare korte, enkle setninger -- det virker umodent
- Unngå også å skrive bare lange setninger -- det blir tungt å lese
